name: Lsio-api
tagline: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub. Docker. Com/r/linuxserver/lsio-api for details.
description: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub.docker.com/r/linuxserver/lsio-api for details.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/lsio-api:version-9eda67ec@sha256:374295622f0cc2e951b2f2b7b431fa1718102d2145335cee84b8c24ce72f46fb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
